These include sleep walking, nightmares, night terrors, and nocturnal seizures. The causes of parasomnias are usually unknown. Some cases are hereditary and may be related to family history. Treatment for sleep walking includes avoiding caffeine and alcohol, getting regular exercise, and maintaining a consistent sleep schedule. Since you are already taking treatment for OSA and parasomnia, you need to continue with these. You should get a second opinion from a neurologist regarding your sleep disturbance. Hopefully, this will help

instruction: Hi doctor,My partner is pregnant with twins of 22 weeks. She has kell antigens in her blood received from a transfusion when my first son is born. Are there any permanent effects that would inhibit them from having a healthy life? I am scared after knowing it. Please help me.
output: 1) Kell group is an autoimmune disease which affects the red blood cells. This means that your body is producing antibodies against these antigens, which may attack the red blood cells of your children. However, as this is not a serious condition, it does not cause any long-term damage to the fetus or child. 2) The best way to avoid the problem is to receive blood from someone who doesn't have the antigen. You should get tested for other groups, such as Rhesus (Rh), Duffy, MNS, C, E, Kidd, etc., as well as the Kell group. 3) If you do happen to have the same antigen, then you will need to get immunoglobulin therapy during labor. 4) Regardless of what your blood type is, you should always use Rh positive blood when donating plasma or platelets.

output: Dear Sir/Madam, From your history, I suspect you may have fibromyalgia or chronic fatigue syn Chat Doctor. instruction: Hi doctor,I had my first tonic clonic (grand mal) seizure seven days ago at work. It lasted 1 minute 30 seconds. I bit my tongue badly, but did not have any incontinence. Beforehand, I was shaking, had a loud beating heart and had a feeling of vertigo and anxiety. Afterwards, I was confused for approximately 15 minutes. I was being very active at the time and was bending down and rising several times to tidy up a room, which may have contributed to feeling faint or having a head rush.I am a 27 year old obese woman. My height is 5\6" and weight is 266 lbs with untreated bulimia that comes and goes in phases since the age of 15. For the previous three months, I alternated between low carbohydrate days, the days I accept as good days and bad days where I may binge and purge up to three times a day. I vomited 12 hours before my seizure and did not eat or drink anything after that. I had 5 hours of sleep and then drove an hour to work. After my seizure, my employer, who happens to be a doctor, gave me lots of water and tea and sent me to a GP. An hour later, I had a blood test and the results came back all normal, but borderline low potassium. My ECG scan is normal and nothing wrong with reflexes or balance. I do not have diabetes. I have also seen a neurologist, who has put the seizure down as isolated and unprovoked.I have not told my GP or my neurologist about my bulimia. My MRI and EEG scans are pending, but my neurologist said that they will probably come back clear. I have never felt my aura before as any indication of epilepsy, minor seizures or myoclonic jerks. I have also scared of my bulimia now, which is a positive. I realize that I am probably clutching at straws or in denial that I may have adult onset epilepsy. My question is that could my seizure have been provoked? Thanks in advance.
output: Hi, thanks for using Chat Doctor. I understand your concern. But I would like to tell you that your seizure was not caused by bulimia. Bulimia can cause electrolyte imbalance and other metabolic disorders which can lead to the development of seizures. So it is important for you to follow up with your neurologist regarding the treatment of bulimia. Regarding your seizure, it is most likely of idiopathic origin-meaning it has no known cause. As such there is no way of predicting the recurrence of the seizure. However, it is possible to prevent future seizures if you take anti-epileptic medications regularly. In addition, you should avoid stressful situations, maintain adequate fluid intake and monitor your blood pressure levels. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 24-year-old with type 1 diabetes looking to conceive. I am currently 145 pounds and 5\6" tall. What do I need to do? Currently, I am taking Insulin.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. As you are suffering from Type 1 Diabetes, it is necessary that your blood sugar level should be maintained under control throughout pregnancy. The normal blood glucose levels during pregnancy for a non-diabetic woman is between 90-100 mg/dl (5-5.5 mmol/L). For a diabetic woman, her blood sugar level should not exceed more than 80 mg/dl (4.5 mmol/L) in fasting state and less than 140 mg/dl (7.8 mmol/L) after meals. In addition to this, she will have to take insulin accordingly. She also has to take folic acid supplements of at least 5 mg per day. You can discuss these issues further with your attending physician. Hope this helps you. Wishing you good

instruction: Hello doctor,My tissue transglutaminase IgA are high but I have not done any biopsy but done only an endoscopy (normal). If my TTG IgA is high then I must be having celiac disease because this level only goes high with celiac disease, am I right? Then why do I need to go for biopsy as it is a painful procedure?
output: 1) Endoscopy is a non-invasive test and can detect many problems in the intestines. 2) Biopsy is a small invasive procedure where they take small samples of tissue from your body and send them to a lab for testing. It helps to know what type of damage is going on in the intestine and how far the inflammation has spread.3) Celiac disease is diagnosed by doing both tests together. Endoscopy will give you an idea if there is damage present, but biopsy will tell you if the damage is due to gluten sensitivity or some other cause.4) In case of doubt, biopsy is recommended.

instruction: Hi doctor,I had a brief interaction with a woman who is very likely to have STD, specifically herpes, and I have a few questions about herpes testing. The full story is that about three weeks ago, after a bad breakup, I went to a massage parlor. The parlor was the type that is sort of seedy and known for extras and the masseuse assumed I wanted sex and was immediately ready to go. I sort of talked her down to a handjob and the masseuse took off her clothes, straddled my legs, and did her thing while I lay on my back. For about 10 seconds during the hand-job, her genital area was pressed against my scrotal area, and she also kissed the shaft of my penis twice. There was no intercourse, and I did not see any herpes lesions on her, but I also was not able to look inside her or get more than a few brief looks between her legs before she was on top of me.After the experience, I was very worried about having contracted herpes from the genital contact, so I got some tests done. An IgM plus a full STD screen at three days after the incident, and an IgG and a second IgM at 10 days after the incident. Everything was negative. I have had no symptoms other than a bump on the inside of my thigh, and I have had bumps before in the same spot due to thigh chafing when I walk. I actually had one on the other thigh before the incident. Currently, it is about 22 days after the incident, and I am planning on getting a third IgM done to be extra sure there has been no change. What worries me is that I have read online that the IgM test is unreliable and that 50 % give false negative results. So basically, my questions are, with no symptoms, three negative IgM for HSV 1 and 2, and a negative IgG, is it safe to assume I do not have herpes? Is the IgM completely unreliable or are three negatives taken at different times conclusive? And is it fine to continue with dating and sexual activity given my current circumstances? Or should I abstain from sex completely for another nine weeks and wait till I can take a more accurate IgG? I started a new relationship a couple weeks after the incident, and I do not want to risk infecting her, but I also do not want to ruin the relationship if I do not need to. I also suffer from generalized anxiety disorder. So, any concrete information you have would be helpful. Lately, I have been having especially bad panic attacks and hot flashes. Currently, I am taking Effexor 75 mg.
output: Hi, Thank you for posting your query. Herpes simplex virus (HSV) is very common and affects around half of the population at some point in their life. It causes painful blisters and sores on the lips, mouth, genitals, hands and feet. These blisters are caused by infection with either Herpes Simplex Virus Type 1 (HSV-1) or Herpes Simplex Virus Type 2 (HSV-2). You have tested negative for both these viruses. However, this does not mean that you do not have herpes. A negative result indicates that you may not have active infection at present. It is possible that you might develop future active infections, and the next time you will test positive for herpes. I suggest that you discuss the above with your doctor and decide whether you should continue your current relationship. Wish you all the best.

Then the doctor prescribed the same Terbanfine 250 mg by mouth, and I took for two weeks no relief. Meanwhile, the infection spreader into another side of thigh corner (groin) as well. Now in third visit doctor has prescribed me Flucanozole 100 mg by mouth for eight days as he thinks my fungus has developed resistance to the earlier drug. It has been four days, and Flucanozole is not working, I am very scared and under trauma that nothing is working for me. My immunity has been very weak since my childhood, and even a coughing infection takes a month to cure. Please help.
output: Hi thanks for contacting Chat Doctor. The condition is called Tina corporal or tinea cruris or jock itch. It is caused by dermatophyte fungi which are organisms that can cause infections. These fungi are found normally on the skin and do not cause problems unless they multiply. Infection can be spread from person to person by direct contact with infected areas or indirectly by touching contaminated surfaces. Treatment options include topical antifungals such as clotrimazole or ketoconazole. Oral fluconazole is also effective in many cases. You should consult your doctor for examination and treatment. Regards

It is important to get the ear checked by an ENT specialist who will examine the ear canal and assess if there is any obstruction. Treatment consists of regular irrigations, use of antihistamines and steroid nasal sprays. If this does not work then surgery might be needed. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have not had a fever for many years (around 15 years or more if I remember correctly). I read somewhere that I should get immunoglobulin checked because I have not got a fever for years. Will it be useful to do this test? If yes, then which ones should I get done as there are multiple tests for immunoglobulin-like G, M, and A? Please advice.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. Immunoglobulins are proteins present in blood plasma of human body. They act against foreign bodies like bacteria, viruses, fungi etc. If these foreign bodies enter our body they will cause infections. For example, when we take antibiotics, they kill the bacterial cells but some amount of bacterial cells may remain alive in our body. The bacterial cells produce antigens which stimulate the production of antibodies by our body. These antibodies neutralize the antigen and thus prevent further proliferation of the bacteria. So, if you don't have any symptoms of infection, you need not worry about your immunoglobulins levels. If you want to know something else, you can ask me through my profile link http://www.ChatDoctor.com/doctors/

output: Hi, Thanks for posting your query. I can understand your concern regarding having painful lumps in the penis. instruction: Hello doctor,My baby is 2 years old and has plagiocephaly. Can it be cured normally?
output: Hi dear, Plagiocephaly means the head shape which is not normal as compared to other babies in general population. In case if your child has only mild or moderate form of the same then there is no harm in leaving it alone unless the child is having severe deformity. The child may have difficulty with hearing and should get checked up by an ENT surgeon to rule out any problem if present. Apart from that there is no need for surgical correction at this age because the skull will become harder when the child grows older and therefore won't allow itself to correct. Hope I could help you.

instruction: Hello doctor,My vision gets blurry, especially when I look at green lights at night. I wake up with a blurry vision every day. And at times, my eyes pain and itch. Please help me.

You should also get a complete blood count (CBC) and a test for syphilis (RPR).3. A careful history and physical examination will often reveal the cause.

instruction: Hello doctor,Can I take Vitamin C because I am anemia patient and what is the name of Vitamin C supplement? My age is 19 years old and my height is 161 cm.
output: Hello, have you been tested for iron deficiency? Iron deficiency can cause anemia and if that is the case then it should be treated with iron supplementation. In addition to this a diet rich in iron such as leafy vegetables, legumes and meat can also help improve your condition. Vitamin C is not used as a treatment for anemia but is taken as a preventative measure against colds. You may want to consider taking a daily multivitamin containing vitamins A, B-complex, C, D, E, and Zinc which will provide you with adequate amounts of most essential vitamins and minerals necessary for good health. Hope this helps

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 34 years old male. I started having incontinence problems about 4 to 6 months ago (cause unknown). It began with issues only happening at night while sleeping. A month ago it had progressed to occasionally not even being able to make it to the bathroom before I began to pee. Then, about four weeks or so ago, while having sex with my girlfriend, I ended up with a fairly large cut or tear right underneath the head of the penis. It has happened before.About 2 to 3 weeks ago I somehow ended up with a UTI and yeast infection. For whatever reason, I have not taken it seriously (major depression) and two nights ago I started having pain (then ended up realizing these were little white ulcers that have since begun to spread rapidly). They are under the head of the penis, on my scrotum, and also on the shaft of my penis. Along with that, last night I realized the lymph node in my right groin was significantly swollen and painful as well. Today that became my lymph node in both my right and now my left groin as well.)Finally, when I woke up today I had a huge swollen ring of skin, underneath the head of my penis, along with everything else. I have had this same swollen ring one time before in my life. It is seriously swollen and more ulcers are on that skin as well. I did a bit of looking at pictures online and I found a condition that is very similar looking (as far as the swollen ring goes,) called paraphimosis. However, I have been circumcised since I was a baby. So I am not thinking that is it. Anyway, I am in fairly severe pain and I am worried about the lymph nodes in my groin (left and right) being swollen, that there is some bad infection spreading in my blood throughout my body. I guess I could be simply paranoid but I went from ignoring this to now freaking out. So I do not believe that this is the case. Please help. Any ideas or thoughts or suggestions? Currently, I am on Xanax, Adderall, Prozac, Abilify, Cymbalta, Suboxone, and Atenolol.
output: 1. The symptoms you describe are typical for an STD. The swelling around your penis is a sign of inflammation. This can occur with STDs like gonorrhea and chlamydia. You should get tested for them if you haven't already done so.2. Your symptoms may also be related to the yeast infection itself. Yeast infections can sometimes cause swelling and ulcers around the penis and testicles. 3. Paraphimosis is a condition where the foreskin becomes stuck behind the tip of the penis. This can happen after trauma or during sexual activity. But you didn't mention any of those things. 4. Pain and swelling in the groin area can also be caused by a serious bacterial infection called cellulitis. This is a serious problem and needs immediate medical attention.5. In summary, I would recommend getting checked out

instruction: Hello doctor,A week back, I slipped and injured my right thumb. There was a cut just below the top side nail with lots of bleeding. The doctor had bandaged it, and the wound seems to have healed. The X-ray report says \evidence of mildly displaced comminuted fracture is seen in the base of the distal phalanx of the right thumb. Rest of the visualized bone appears to be normal.\ The doctor has advised surgery which I do not want. Please advise if surgery can be avoided.
output: 1. You should know that your injury is quite severe as there is a fracture.2. In such cases, if the fracture site is out of joint then surgery (open reduction) is required to fix the fractured fragments together by using internal fixation material like screw, plates etc.3. If the fracture site is within the articular surface then closed reduction may suffice.4. If the fracture is not displaced then simple splinting will do.5. So, as far as possible, avoid any surgical procedure as it involves risks.6. Hope this helps you.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am on birth control pills called Yasmin for around four months. I take pills daily at night after sex that is anytime between 10 p.m. and 12.30 a.m. In the current cycle, I missed the pill twice but took it immediately the next morning and then took the normal pill of that particular day at night as well.I want to check can I have unprotected sex (without a condom) and still be safe from pregnancy? Should I stop the pills now so that I get periods immediately (even though my period is due this week) and when periods start, the same day I start my fresh pack of pills? Will this ensure safety if I plan to have unprotected sex this week?
output: 1. You should not take emergency contraception if you are already taking regular oral contraceptives (birth control pills). It may cause serious side effects.2. The best way to prevent unwanted pregnancies while using hormonal contraceptives is by using another form of protection such as barrier methods like condoms or diaphragms.3. Yes, you can have unprotected sex and take an emergency contraceptive pill.4. No, you don't need to stop taking your pills. Just wait for your periods to come.5. Emergency contraceptive pills are not effective in preventing pregnancies caused by sexual intercourse during the fertile phase of the menstrual cycle.

instruction: Hi doctor,My factor V Leiden showed a positive outcome before three months. I got Depo birth control shot before three months. I have heavy bleeding and blood clots now. Please suggest.

Can I take them more to boost my immunity? Also, I took Panadol cold and flu. Please advice.
output: 1. It is recommended to take vitamin C supplements for 3-4 weeks after getting a cold or flu.2. This will help your body recover faster.3. Vitamin C is very safe at this dose and should not cause any side effects.4. You can continue these supplements as long as symptoms persist.5. However, if you get diarrhea, then you should stop the tablets immediately.6. In addition, you can take zinc lozenges which also hasten recovery. Hope this helps you.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am reviewing the patient care of a 4-year-old child diagnosed with the flu. He was having trouble breathing, so we called an ambulance. I was very apprehensive about him receiving any drugs from a doctor. His pulse was 149, 161, and 150. The medic then said his pulse was falling, which I did not see. He then requested an order to give Epinephrine, which does not make sense to me. His pulse rate then fell quickly. What is your opinion?
output: Hi...welcome to Chat Doctor. Your concern is that why pulse fall after giving epinephrine injection??? This is normal as it is one of the side effects of epinephrine injection. It will come down in few minutes. So don't worry. In my opinion if you have given enough amount of epinephrine than you can discharge the kid home, otherwise he needs to be admitted in hospital for further treatment. Hope this answers your question. If you have additional questions or follow-up questions then please do not hesitate in writing to us. Wishing you good health.

instruction: Hello doctor,I took an i-pill eight days before my menstrual period was due and after five days of taking it, I started bleeding. The bleeding lasted for three to four days with light spotting towards the end. But, now I have again started to bleed much ahead of my menstrual period. This does not happen usually. It is slightly accompanied with pain in the stomach and back. What could be the reason? Is there anything wrong? I am a type 1 diabetic for the past 14 years and I am insulin dependent, but my blood glucose level remains in control. Please advise.
output: Hi, thanks for posting your query. Bleeding from the uterus is known as abnormal menstruation. It can occur due to many reasons like hormonal imbalance, stress, thyroid dysfunction etc. You should get a complete hormone profile done to rule out any hormonal imbalances. Get your sugar levels checked to check for possible diabetes related problems. Avoid excessive physical activity during this time. Take rest and take a course of antibiotics if you have fever or bodyache. Hope this information helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,A 76-year-old female\s CT scan showed the following.Clinical information: CT scan of the head, volume scan of the whole brain obtained without IV contrast administration.Findings: Large CSF density hypodense lesion is seen in the right cerebellar hemisphere. This suggests that she might have had multiple episodes of stroke in the past which could be due to blockage of blood vessels in the brain. However, there are certain medications available which can help in preventing further episodes of stroke in the future. So it would be better if you consult a neurologist and discuss these issues with him. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 25-year-old lady about 6 to 7 weeks pregnant. My HbA1c is 12. What should I do?
output: 12 is not high enough for immediate action. However, you need to stop any medications that may cause hypoglycemia or diabetes.  You also need to check your blood sugar levels and see if it is elevated when you are not taking insulin.  If you have problems with controlling your blood sugar then you will need to start insulin as soon as possible.  This can be done at the time of delivery.  The best way to control this is to keep it under good control before the baby is born so that there is less chance of complications in the newborn.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 32 years old. Last year, I had a cyst on my ovary and I had to undergo an operation to remove it. The doctors ended up removing both my ovaries. I was told to take Microgynon to balance my hormones. I have been very forgetful with my intake of the tablet for the whole year and have not been consistent. Now recently, as usual, I forgot to take tablets for a few days and started bleeding. I was worried it could be something more serious, but doctors told me that it was fine and it was because of the missed tablets. I have gained weight and my stomach appears bloated. At one point I was convinced that I was pregnant as I felt weird movements. The doctors did a scan and there was nothing wrong. I also went through a phase of fatigue. I sometimes get pain in my lower abdomen. I went to another doctor for advice as my cyst was never tested for cancer. He told me to go for thyroid, menopause and cholesterol test. I have not done them yet. They said that it may be the symptoms of menopause. I just wanted to enquire about my health, whether if this is really a menopause and the further steps to be taken. Please advise.
output: 1) You can get your thyroid levels checked, but there is no need to worry about that.  It is not related to menopausal symptoms. 2) Menopause occurs when regular periods stop for 12 months.  So even though you have stopped taking microgynon, you will still be considered to be in menopause until you have had 12 consecutive months without menstruation. 3) So menopause has nothing to do with the symptoms you are having. 4) The symptoms you are describing are typical of PMS (premenstrual syn Chat Doctor. 5) To treat PMS, you should try to reduce stress and anxiety.  This can be accomplished by relaxation exercises, yoga or meditation. 6) If these measures don't help, you might want to consider low-dose antidepressants such as Escitalopram, which

instruction: Hello doctor,A few weeks ago, a red or pink scar and extra skin showed up at my urethral or where the pee comes out. What has to be done? Currently, I am taking Monistat 7 and had a yeast infection previously.

instruction: Hello doctor,How far is the left ventricular diastolic dysfunction serious? I am 68 years old. I also suffer from diabetes, BP, heart issues. I have had an angioplasty done 10 years back and again an angiography five years back. Please advice.
output: Thanks for your question on Chat Doctor. Left ventricle diastolic dysfunction is a very common finding in elderly patients with chronic hypertension or diabetes mellitus. It is not a serious problem unless there is associated cardiac failure. So don't worry about this. But better to get done ECG and 2d echo to rule out any significant coronary artery disease or valvular heart disease. You should also be on regular antihypertensive and lipid lowering therapy.

instruction: Hello doctor,I commenced taking Femosten last month because I was not getting a period for the last six months. Prior to this, I got them intermittently for 12 to 18 months. For several months, I would just get my period for several consecutive months. My cycle has always been 28 days. My periods never differed, perhaps a little heavier than usual. I suffered constant hot flushing for six months. So the doctor prescribed Femoston which dealt with that issue. She did advise perhaps I would still have some bleeding. I have never had any breakthrough bleeding but last month I got a period, lasting for usual five days and yesterday, I have had another period. Just wondering about this. I am due to see my GP soon for a pap smear and review the Femosten. Should I make an earlier booking?
output: Hello, The irregularities in your menstrual cycles are most likely due to hormonal imbalances. You should consult an endocrinologist who can help you in diagnosing the cause of these hormone imbalances and treat it accordingly. Also, you should discuss with her whether you need to continue with the medication or not. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further.

instruction: Hello doctor,My teeth are not in order. How to correct them?

In case if you are having any decay then it has to be restored with filling material. If there is gum problem then scaling will help. In case if you are having any missing teeth then implants can be used for replacing it. Please consult your dentist and go through all these procedures. Hope this helps. Regards.

instruction: Hello doctor,I suffered from ringworm (tinea corporis) long back. I used Itraconazole 100 mg for two weeks. Now the same has appeared on buttocks. For this, what medicine needs to be used? If I use these tablets, will it cause any other side effects? The problem is like round shaped and it is spreading. This is the problem. Please suggest me medication.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. From your question I understand that you have had tinea corporis in the past, and now suffer from it again. Tinea corporis is a fungal infection of the skin, which can occur anywhere over the body or part of the body. Once you have taken an antifungal agent like fluconazole or ketoconazole, there is no need to take another course of treatment. You may take a short course of 2-3 weeks if the infection recurs. But I would advise you to see a dermatologist who can diagnose your condition properly and treat it accordingly. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am schizophrenic but recovered. I would like to know what next after recovering symptomatically, functionally and cognitively over 2 years now. Do I get to gradually taper off my medications? Do I get back the level of energy I had during my pre-psychotic period before my first relapse?
output: 1) You should never stop any psychiatric medication without consulting your treating psychiatrist as it may lead to relapse or even death in some cases.2) Medicines can be reduced with help of your psychiatrist depending upon your progress.3) You will need regular follow up for at least few more years.4) During this time, you should also focus on improving social skills, self-management, problem solving skills etc.5) Increased physical activity is also important for recovery. Hope I have answered your question. Let me know if I can assist you further.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 36-year-old male. I previously had a chlamydia infection and was successfully treated. Will such previous infection interfere or affect my fertility? I recently had a scrotal examination and the results were normal.
output: 1. Yes it may affect your fertility if not treated properly.2. It is important to know that Chlamydia trachomatis can cause serious complications in men including infertility and epididymitis (inflammation of the tube that carries sperm from testicles). 3. Treatment for chlamydial infections consists of antibiotics, usually azithromycin. It is very important to take all medicines as prescribed by your doctor. 4. You should also be tested for other STDs because they often occur together with Chlamydia.5. If you have symptoms like painful urination, discharge from penis, then you should visit your doctor immediately and get yourself checked up. Hope this answers your question.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am a 23-year-old girl. I underwent a rhinoplasty six days ago. Today my surgeon took the cast off, and I saw my nose with a lot of swelling, I have a concern that I will not get the shape as I want a thinner dorsum. I am uploading the pre-surgical and post-surgical pictures. Is it possible for my dorsum to get thinner after the resolution of the swelling? Or will it remain the same?
output: Hi there, There is no way to predict how much swelling will subside in any particular individual. It can take up to a year or more to fully resolve depending on genetic factors and your own healing response. The best thing to do now is to be patient and wait until the swelling resolves completely. In the meantime, you should keep your head elevated when sleeping (use multiple pillows) and avoid strenuous exercise/lifting heavy objects. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I did my blood test. The hemoglobin is astonishingly low at 4.1. I did ferritin test and B12 test and the results are attached. Blood transfusion was done - one bottle. The hemoglobin increase to 5.5, but again reduced to 5.1. I have a fever on and off. What problem do I have? I am feeling very weak. How long will the treatment go on?
output: 1) Hemoglobin of 4.1 g/DL is abnormally low. 2) Ferritin level of 110 is not significant for anemia.3) Vitamin B-12 is within normal range.4) You may need iron supplementation as well as folic acid supplementation.5) If hemoglobin remains low despite above measures then you may require blood transfusion.6) Apart from this, you can take plenty of water, fruits and vegetables in your diet. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,What are some of the most significant health mistakes that people need to stop making, especially as they age?
output: The most significant health mistake that people make is not getting enough sleep. Lack of adequate restful sleep leads to poor concentration, reduced energy levels and poor memory. It also interferes with the immune system and increases risk for infection and disease. Poor sleep may also contribute to depression, anxiety and other mental health issues. Other common health mistakes include smoking and excessive alcohol consumption. Smoking can lead to lung cancer and COPD, while heavy alcohol intake can cause liver damage. People should also avoid unhealthy diets high in fatty foods, sugars and salt. Eating lots of fruits and vegetables, fish, nuts and legumes will help maintain good health and prevent many diseases.

instruction: Hello doctor,My wisdom tooth is growing. It is very painful. What is the solution?

For temporary relief you can take analgesics like diclofenac sodium (if not allergic) and do warm saline rinses. Hope this helps. Take care.

instruction: Hi doctor,I have episodes of bad sinuses every year. Last year, I had hay fever with an extreme blocked nose. I went to my GP, and he gave me sinus injection. This time, injection has not helped me.I have ear pain, head pain, clogged nose, with itchy eyes and itchy throat. When I lie down to sleep, the pain gets worse, and I have throbbing pain in the head. I have nonstop sneezing for 30 minutes in the mornings. I have also taken two courses of antibiotics. But there is no relief. In the mornings, when I sneeze, the mucous seems to be yellow with some blood present in it. Later, the mucus becomes clear again. I cannot sleep at night because of the throbbing head pain. I will try to change directions, and I will add more pillows to sleep. But nothing has helped me.
output: 1) You should be checked for allergic rhinitis-it is likely that this is causing your symptoms.2) There are many medications that can help. Some of these include montelukast, albuterol, fexofenadine, loratadine, cetirizine etc.3) Antihistamines such as Ben Chat Doctor. 4) Nasal corticosteroids may also be helpful. They can be used daily or on an as needed basis if they cause insomnia.5) Decongestants should also be avoided when possible.6) Avoidance of exposure to known allergens (as much as possible!)7) If you do not get any relief from taking medication alone then allergy testing would be recommended to determine what substances you are allergic to and how to avoid them.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a nurse and I had the stomach flu about a week ago and decided to take a VD pelvis and abdomen radiograph of myself. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I was diagnosed with IBS-D five years ago. This month tests have identified high levels of blastocystis hominis in my stool as well as yeast and imbalance in gut flora. I am traveling away and I am wondering what the best course of action for me is?I have done comprehensive stool analysis and recent full blood test.
output: 1) Blastocystis hominis is not a serious parasite.2) It has been found in many countries and is considered to be a colonizing organism that can cause diarrhea but usually does not require treatment unless it causes severe symptoms.3) The yeasts and imbalances in gut flora may be related to your IBS or they could be a separate issue.4) You should continue to take probiotics (if you are taking them).5) As long as you do not have any other symptoms such as abdominal pain, fever, weight loss, etc., then you will probably be fine.6) If you develop any new symptoms, you should see your doctor again.

instruction: Hello doctor,My wife\s last period date was two months ago. After one month, we came to know through blood tests that she is pregnant. She had her first ultrasound 10 days ago and the baby is fine at five weeks and five days with a heartbeat of 114. But for the last three to four days, she saw some blood in her urine. Today, there was some flow like a period and we consulted the doctor.We did an ultrasound today. They could not find the baby\s heartbeat. So, we did blood tests. My wife is under a lot of stress because of bleeding and no heartbeat. Does this mean, she has got a miscarriage? Do we still have a hope to revive her pregnancy?
output: 1) Bleeding from vagina after missed periods may be due to early abortion or threatened abortion.2) Any bleeding after 5 weeks of gestation is considered as abortion.3) In case of threatened abortion, if the fetus is alive then it can be saved by using medicines.4) Ultrasonography after 5 weeks of gestation is very important to see whether the fetal heart beat is present.5) You should get the ultrasound done immediately and report to your doctor.

instruction: Hi doctor,My sperm count is low; it has dropped from 18 million to 3 million within a period of five months time. I have been diagnosed with bilateral varicocele. According to him, surgical correction will certainly increase the sperm count. In case it does not work, then he asked me to go with ART. Please suggest, as to which one I should opt for? output: 1st thing I would like to say that there is no relation between varicocele & low sperm count. Even if your sperm count is normal, still you can ask for surgery because varicocele may cause infertility. Varicocele is not an uncommon condition, but its effect on fertility is very rarely seen. So there is no need to worry about that. Secondly, the reason behind your low sperm count is not known to us, so we cannot comment on that. But generally low sperm count is due to some problem in the seminal vesicle or epididymis. If your sperm count is normal then there is no need to worry at all.

instruction: Hello doctor,My mom is a diabetic patient. She is given Glimser forte 1 and Glytrin met 1000 for her current blood sugar condition by a diabetologist. From last two days, she is feeling exhausted and very weak. Is it because of the tablets or any other reasons?

instruction: Hello doctor,For the past two months, I have had a pretty consistent elevated heart rate. Not by a lot but noticeable for me compared to what I was coming from.I cut out alcohol and caffeine and that helped but it always returns. My resting heart rate (I wear an Apple watch) is pretty consistent in the 53-58 range. But when I get up, go up or downstairs, it will jump to 100 pretty fast, then average out in the 80\s as I move about my day. When I am sitting at work it is 78-85 bpm. This is a good 8-10 bpm faster than when I am at peak health. I am not sure what is going on.I did a fair bit of cocaine and took some ED pills a few times (with the cocaine) before three months, so I wondered if maybe there is a connection. I have not done anything like that since then.I am a runner, but now when I run or jump it goes up to 150 bpm and higher pretty fast. If I push myself anywhere close to hard I am at 170-180 bpm pretty easily, so I slow down. And it seems my body does not recover quite as fast. So I have stopped running hard and just do light jogs, and play tennis. I recover pretty easily there. But it is annoying as I want to run and push myself.I will go two to three days with no caffeine, alcohol and then I notice my walking around rate is lower, like what it used to be mid 70\s. When it is like that I can feel it noticeably, I feel much more complete and whole. I feel great and no shortness of breath. So then I will have a few glasses of wine that night, and maybe a dessert (I like sugar at night) and I will lay down to sleep and my heart seems to jump up to 85-95 bpm for a while and it takes two to three hours before it rests at 53-58 bpm. And then the cycle starts again. I am so confused I do not know what the deal is. Is it the alcohol or sugar? I drink this one type of white wine a lot but I have noticed my heart rate does not react as much when I just drink beer. One night, I had white wine then tequila and my resting rate was like 68-78 bpm all night. I saw a doctor about three weeks ago and they did an ECG and listened to my heart and it showed no issues or irregularities. I do not have heart pain, though I did have a few sharp pains over the past two months maybe two to three times all lasting about one second and then it is gone all when I am lying down in bed trying to go to sleep. I do have shortness of breath due to the elevated heart rate when I am carrying stuff, going upstairs, etc. I do not have pain in my chest, jaw, left arm, etc.Sorry, this is so long but I really would love to discuss this with someone who maybe has heard of this before. To be clear what is annoying and confusing me is that my heart rate will steadily be 8-10 bpm higher at all times (aside from resting rate) for like a 7-10 days before it feels like it goes back to normal. But then there is always something that sets it off again. I never see it spike over 105 or so.
output: Hi, Thank you for your question. I understand your concern regarding high heart rate. As you mentioned you were having high heart rate for last couple of months and also have a history of cocaine and ED pills use, which may cause damage to heart muscle. You should consult a cardiologist for proper evaluation and management. A cardiac ultrasound, lipid profile, blood sugar levels, thyroid function test and EKG will help us to evaluate further. You should avoid stress and anxiety. You need to take medicines like beta blockers to control your heart rate. Regular exercise and yoga can help to reduce anxiety. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have been to four urologists and none of them know what is wrong with me. Prostatitis may be caused by a bacterial infection, which may be treated with antibiotics (if the culture is positive for bacteria).4. Chronic prostatitis requires a medication such as Flomax, which relax the smooth muscles of the bladder neck.5. In case of no improvement, you may require further evaluation, including an endoscopy of the genitourinary tract.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 43 year old male. I have been taking Xarelto for about a year-and-a-half due to a pulmonary embolism that I had. They were very small. output: 1) You need to understand that Xarelto (rivaroxaban) is an anti-clotting agent, and it prevents formation of clots in the body. Your past history of thrombotic event is important. Other risk factors include smoking, obesity, diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, family history of thrombosis etc.3) You should discuss all these issues with your treating physician who will decide whether it would be appropriate to stop taking Xarelto.

instruction: Hello doctor,I got my wisdom tooth extracted a few weeks ago, and I am concerned about a piece of red tissue growth in my socket. I am not sure if it is just a new forming tissue. Please clarify.
output: Hi Tina, Thanks for writing in. Red tissue formation in the socket after extraction can be due to either granulation tissue or periodontal flap overgrowth. Granulation tissue occurs when there is an incomplete healing of the socket after extraction. This is usually seen when there has been a lot of bleeding during extraction and/or during the first few days after extraction. It is a normal part of healing and will gradually disappear as healing progresses. Periodontal flap overgrowth occurs when there is a re-growth of gum over the area where the bone was removed during extraction. This is also a normal part of healing and will also gradually resolve with time. Both these conditions do not require any treatment unless they cause discomfort or pain. I hope this helps you.

The most common symptoms include abdominal pain, diarrhea, weight loss, anemia, fatigue, and loss of appetite.3) Intestinal parasitic infections are caused by ingestion of eggs or larvae from contaminated food or water.4) Intestinal parasites do not cause any symptom during their early stages of development. It is only after they reach maturity that they start causing the above-mentioned symptoms.5) In addition, many cases of intestinal parasitism may go unnoticed because patients do not show any symptoms at all.6) Worm

instruction: Hello doctor,Is beta thalassemia trait a serious case?
output: Yes, it is. It can be serious if not treated properly and timely. In this condition, there is decreased production of hemoglobin which causes anemia. The severity of anemia depends upon how much globin is deficient in the body. A child with beta-thalassemia trait may have mild to severe symptoms like fatigue, pallor, weakness, rapid heart rate, etc. So I advise you to get yourself tested for the same. You should avoid marrying someone who has beta-thalassemia trait as your child may inherit the disorder from you.

Yes, you can take the test for Chlamydia and Trichomonas, which will help you to diagnose the infection. Your results will come back in few days. You don't need to worry about it. The oral HPV virus is transmitted through kissing, but it does not lead to any serious health problems. It usually goes away without treatment. Hope this helps. Take care

instruction: Hello doctor,For the past three weeks, I have had my normal right eye floaters seem strange. I noticed peripheral flashes when blinking and walking and quick black narrow lines. output: Hi, Thanks for writing in. The symptoms that you describe are suggestive of posterior vitreous detachment. This is caused by a separation of the vitreous gel from the back of the eye which causes it to pull on the retina causing flashing lights and floaters. It is usually harmless and does not require any treatment. However, if there is sudden increase in floaters, then you need to get your vision checked immediately as this can be a sign of hemorrhage or tear in the retina. Please do see an Ophthalmologist at once. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,My father had partial penectomy two weeks ago, and our doctor has suggested for another surgery. I am sending his postsurgical reports. Can you please let us know if surgery is required, and he still have cancer?
output: 1. Yes, your father might need further treatment depending upon the histopathological findings of the tissue removed during the first surgery.2. The post-operative report suggests that there was carcinoma in situ in the anterior urethra which means that the cancer cells were confined to the mucosa (innermost layer) of the urethra alone.3. Cancer spreading beyond the mucosa into deeper layers of the urethral wall is called invasive cancer. Invasion of the muscle layer or lymph nodes would mean that the cancer has spread to other parts of the body also.4. Please note that the diagnosis of cancer is made only after thorough examination by a pathologist.5. We suggest consulting an Oncologist / Urologist who will examine him personally before deciding about any further treatment. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I was recommended by my cardiologist for a heart valve replacement surgery as my latest echocardiogram results, both transthoracic (TTE) and transesophageal (TEE), revealed that my mitral valve prolapse had worsened. output: Hi, thanks for writing to us. Mitral Valve Prolapse (MVP) is not a reversible condition but may be improved with medication or surgical correction of the problem. The severity of the regurgitation depends upon the degree of prolapse and its impact on the functioning of the valves. A mild grade leakage is usually associated with no symptoms at all while a more serious degree can cause breathlessness, palpitations, chest pain etc. It is best assessed by an experienced Cardiac Surgeon after a detailed examination of your heart.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am suffering from anxiety and social phobia. I consulted my psychiatrist to use either Citalopram or Mirtazapine. The other possibility is that your headache could be due to some sort of cervical spondylosis/ degenerative disc disease causing compression of the nerves in the neck region leading to referred pain in the head.4. It will help you know if you are overweight or not.2) After calculating BMI, you can work out with weights according to your fitness level.3) Avoid cardio exercises like running, cycling etc. as it won't give any benefit for muscle building.4) Do at least three sets of each exercise.5) Use heavy weight lifting but do not try to lift more than what your body can handle.6) Take protein supplements after working out.7) Eat healthy food.

instruction: Dear Doctor,I want to delay my periods for a week. Earlier my periods have been very sporadic.Just wanted to know whether, is there any way which can help in delaying the periods by a week without disturbing the overall cycle?
output: 1) You may take tablet Yasmin/Yasminelle (combined oral contraceptive pill) for 21 days starting from day 9 of your menstruation. This will delay the period by one week. But it should be taken only when you are sure that you do not wish to get pregnant. 2) Another option would be to take progesterone pill like medroxyprogesterone acetate for about 10-14 days starting from around day 15 of your menstrual cycle. This will also delay the next period by one week.

instruction: Hello doctor,I had a CT scan today and two punctate stones were found in the mid-lower portion of my right kidney. I was advised they measured 1 to 2 mm. Is lithotripsy an option? Can these stones get bigger? Does the location of the stones have any significance? I did have calcium oxalate stones seven years ago. At the moment, I do not have bad pain. A recent urine culture found no infection. If these are calcium oxalate too, anything I can do to may help dissolve them given they are small?
output: 1) I think that yes, Lithography is an option for your case. It is a procedure in which stones are broken into smaller pieces by using ultrasonic waves and then passed out through the urinary tract. 2) The location of the stone has some importance as it may cause obstruction if located at the lower part of the ureter or bladder neck.3) No, the size of the stone doesn't matter much.4) You should try to avoid foods rich in oxalates (like spinach, chocolate, tea, peanuts etc.)5) Yes, there are many cases of dissolution of stones with medicines like alpha blockers or diuretics.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 36 years old and had unprotected sex with my husband on 18th at night. Although he pulled out we are suspecting pregnancy as there can be 1 % chance of ejaculation. I had my last period on the 7th and usually, I get my periods one to three days before the expected time. I took Unwanted 72 on the 21st afternoon. But after taking it, I was feeling stomach and back pain in the lower region along with cramps. Though I am not feeling any other symptoms of pregnancy like nausea, vomiting etc, which I even did not have during my first pregnancy except stomach pain like periods. Will Unwanted 72 will be effective in my case? Can it stop fertilization/implantation? Am I pregnant or is it a side effect of the emergency pill? I am still feeling pain but it is less now. When can I expect my next period or when should I go for pregnancy kit test? I am already having a kid of 2 years and do not want a second one. In case I am pregnant, please guide me how to get it aborted.
output: 1) The emergency contraceptive pill (ECP) will work only if you have taken it within 72 hours of unprotected intercourse. 2) ECP does not prevent implantation of the egg into the uterus wall. It prevents the release of an egg from the ovary, and thus stops pregnancy by stopping the sperm from entering the vagina. Pregnancy cannot occur without the egg being released. 3) You need to take the regular birth control pills regularly for 21 consecutive days starting on the first day of your menses to avoid pregnancy. 4) The ECP pill may cause early menstrual bleeding due to its hormonal effects. It may also cause some cramping due to the hormones.5) A urine pregnancy test done about 10-12 days after missed period would be positive only if you were pregnant.

instruction: Hi doctor,What are the long-term consequences of bad posture? Please explain.
output: Hi, thanks for posting your query at Chat Doctor! Bad posture can lead to problems such as pain in back and neck muscles, headaches, dizziness, fatigue, breathing difficulties, digestive disorders, gastrointestinal problems etc. Postural problems can also cause a person to have difficulty sleeping or concentrating. It may also result in decreased physical activity levels which further worsens the condition. It is therefore important to maintain good posture. You should avoid prolonged sitting in one position and try to change positions often. Take frequent breaks during work or study sessions. Get up from your desk and walk around every hour. The white discharge with smell can be due to fungal infection like candidiasis or bacterial infections like bacterial vaginosis. I would suggest you to consult an Internal medicine specialist/ Gynecologist who will examine and treat accordingly. Meanwhile, you can take antifungals like fluconazole 150 mg once daily for a week along with antihistamines like cetirizine 10 mg twice daily. This may help reduce the symptoms. Take care. Hope this information was helpful to you. Wish you good health.

instruction: Hello doctor,My eyes get watery when I talk to people or when I am nervous. Why is that happening?
output: Hi, dear friend. I understand your concern and would like to tell you that itchy eyes can occur due to several reasons such as allergies (allergic conjunctivitis), infection, etc., and it is not uncommon for them to be associated with anxiety or stress. In addition, they may also be related to environmental factors such as dust, pollen, smoke, etc. So, I suggest you to consult an ophthalmologist once and get yourself examined thoroughly so that he/she can diagnose the underlying cause of your problem and treat it accordingly. Hope this helps. Take care.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 23 years old. My thigh and arm have more hair than other parts of the body since I am 15. I want to get rid of it, so please suggest me treatment.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. The excessive hair growth in the thigh and arms can be due to hormonal imbalance or an inherited condition called hirsutism. It is not possible for us to diagnose this without examining you. You need to consult your family physician and get evaluated. For now, you can try using a depilatory cream or waxing. But these methods have to be done every few days to keep the hair under control. Hope this helps. Regards.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have diabetes since the last 11 to 12 years, and I started taking medicines given by my family doctor. Presently, I am taking Glimisave M2 (one tablet in the morning and evening), Dynaglipt 20 (one tablet in the morning), and Absolut 3G (one in the evening). My health is fine, and I do not have any other diseases. Recently, my blood sugar level showed up high, so my family doctor advised me to consult a diabetologist to control blood sugar level. Please help me. I have attached my test reports.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. As your blood sugar levels were very high, your doctor has rightly advised for a dietician and a physician opinion. You need to follow a proper diet and regular exercise routine. The best way to control this condition is by lifestyle modifications like avoiding of food with high glycemic index, following a low fat diet, avoiding refined sugars and starches, eating more fiber, increasing fruits and vegetables intake etc. Regular physical activity is also important. You should try to lose weight if you are obese. You can discuss all these things with your treating doctor. Hope this helps. Take care.

instruction: Hello doctor,A known 16-year-old son misbehaves with others, not staying at home, does not care about his family, passes the time with his bad company, behaving rudely to parents, and not studying properly. Parents have no control over him, and he does not care when they request him to focus on studies. He does not ask what we say. All these happen within two years of time when he joins with a new circle of friends. Last time he tried committing suicide, writing a statement against his parents as a reason for his death. After his suicide attempt, he is forcing his parents to give him expensive things. Nobody can speak even a single word against him, as it is right or wrong. Otherwise, he will take the next step to attempt suicide. He is not under the control of anybody. We think he needs treatment to stabilize his mind.
output: 1) The symptoms you describe indicate that your son may be suffering from depression. Depression is a mental illness which is characterized by sad mood, low energy, decreased interest in activities, Chat Doctor. 2) I would advise you to consult a psychiatrist who will examine him and assess whether he meets criteria of major depressive disorder.3) Treatment options include medication (e.g., SSRIs), counseling and/or combination of both. Medications need to be taken regularly to get maximum benefit, and if necessary, dose adjustments can be made.4) You should also seek help from a qualified psychologist who can guide you through the various treatment options including cognitive behavioral therapy and insight oriented therapy.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am 18 and struggling with anger issues and impulsive behavior which I am unable to stop. I seriously think that I am quickly getting depressed and developing anxiety and repulsive behavior. I have had many past incidents which might have reflected upon my change in attitude change, and so I want to get rid of this. Please help me.
output: Hi there, Thank you for asking Chat Doctor. I can understand your concern. Anger is an emotion like any other and it does not need to be controlled. We may control our reactions to anger but we cannot control anger itself. Anger is natural and healthy and should not be suppressed or ignored. It is important that one knows how to channelize his/her anger in positive ways. You need to learn techniques to handle anger. Firstly, recognize what triggers your anger. Once you know what sets you off, you can begin to work on controlling your reaction. Secondly, try to find out why you feel angry in the first place. This will help you to identify the root cause of your problem. Thirdly, practice breathing exercises. This helps to calm down your body and mind. Fourthly, use relaxation techniques such as yoga and meditation. Lastly, talk to someone close to you about your feelings. T

instruction: Hello doctor,My 76-year-old father went for a routine checkup where his X-ray report mentioned non-homogenous opacity in right mid and lower zones. Also, his TLC level was 15.7. I do not want to see him in pain if he would be advised to undergo any surgery or go for chemotherapy. He is old aged and has undergone angioplasty twice. He coughs during the night and sometimes in the day.He is a non-smoker and does yoga regularly and morning exercise. He is fit and does not have a fever. In view of the above description, please advise me the proper course of action.
output: 1) The best treatment option depends upon what exactly is causing this opacity in the lungs.2) A chest x-ray can only tell us that there is an opacity in the lungs. It cannot tell us what it is.3) CT scan will give us more information about the nature of this opacity and its relationship with other structures such as airways etc.4) This can help decide whether surgery is required or not.5) Surgery may be indicated if the cause is obstructive (e.g., due to a tumor).6) Chemo therapy may also be needed depending upon the cause. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further.

instruction: Hello doctor,Usually, I let my cats go out and play in the backyard. They frequently bring in fleas and bugs in the house. So I get flea and bug bites. I usually get red bumps on the areas of my legs and lower legs. But recently I notice that there is a confined area that looks like a scab. This is how it happened? The area was really itchy so I started scratching it a lot. After this I noticed a fluid or watery stuff coming out of it. After this, I noticed a scab formed in that area. It is dark red and looked strange.So I took a picture of it and asked a doctor online. He said it was an early form of cellulitis, and suggested some antibiotics for it. I did another consultation with a doctor online, and he said it is a minor allergy like dermatitis from the flea bites and suggested some cream and antibiotics. I am confused. So, I went to my doctor today and she told me she does not think it is cellulitis. However, she can prescribe me antibiotics in case it is cellulitis. I heard most of the time if someone has cellulitis but there being treated with antibiotics the prognosis is very good and the infection leaves in about seven to ten days. If you do not take antibiotics it can be life-threatening. Is it true?The antibiotic I was prescribed was Cephalexin 500 mg one capsule four times a day for 10 days. Is taking four times a day means like in the morning, afternoon, evening, and night? I thought of takiing it twice a day. I am confused. I am going to take a picture of that area. Please let me know if it is cellulitis? It looks like a scab though. Can cellulitis or even minor cellulitis look like a scab? In your opinion should I take the antibiotics? Does it look like cellulitis to you, or just a flee allergy reaction that got itchy? I have attached a picture.
output: Hi, Thanks for writing in. Cellulitis is a bacterial infection which causes inflammation of the skin. It is usually caused by streptococcus or staphylococcus bacteria. Usually the symptoms are fever, increased pain, redness, warmth and swelling over the affected area. In your case, as per history given, the history of flea bites and constant scratching seems to indicate that the cellulitis might have been caused due to insect bite. You were rightly advised antibiotics. Yes, you need to take them four times a day (morning, noon, evening, night) for at least 10 days. If you stop taking them before the course is completed then there is chance of recurrence of the infection. Please continue the treatment. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have to go to urine a number of times especially in the night and that was beyond control. I am male, age 56.
output: 1) Increased frequency of urination can be due to many reasons like urinary tract infection or kidney stones.2) Consult your physician for physical examination and investigations like routine hologram, random blood sugar, urine microscopy and culture, ultrasound of abdomen and pelvis3) You may need further investigation like IVP if needed.4) Treatment will depend upon findings. Hope this helps you.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am suffering from severe stretch marks problem, which is increasing day by day. What can I do to get rid of it? And also I want to remove the old marks which are present near my belly, armpits and above shoulder. Please help.
output: 1) Stretch marks are the result of damage to the dermis layer of skin when there is rapid growth or weight gain. The skin stretches beyond its capacity to accommodate the extra tissue, resulting in the formation of stretch marks. These marks occur most commonly during pregnancy, adolescence, and rapid weight gain due to bodybuilding.2) Treating stretch marks requires multiple approaches which include use of topical creams containing vitamin E, corticosteroids, antioxidants, retinoids, chemical peels, laser resurfacing, etc.3) You should apply Vitamin C serum on your skin twice daily for at least 6 months.4) Applying moisturizing lotions like aloe vera gel after showering will help reduce inflammation.5) Take Omega-3 fatty acids supplements for improving elasticity of the skin. Hope this helps

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a male, and for the past week, I had pain while urinating, especially at night. Sometimes the pain lasts after I urinate and feels like there is acid or something still in my urethra or something, it is hard to explain. I am not sexually active, so I cannot be an STI. I think it may be a UTI. I have some Amoxiclav which I had prescribed for a skin infection and never used so I am taking Amoxiclav for this but not sure how long should I take it for and standard dosage? Currently, I am taking it three times a day, so far pain (I think it is subsiding). Should I get checked at doctors if Amoxiclav does not work?
output: 1) You need to see your primary care physician for evaluation of your symptoms and examination. 2) It would be helpful to know what type of antibiotic you are taking - whether it is broad spectrum or specific to one organism. 3) Urinalysis is important to rule out any infection and to identify any other pathology. 4) In general, treatment with antibiotics is continued until a culture and sensitivity report is available. 5) In case of acute uncomplicated urinary tract infections, usually a 7-day course of antibiotics is sufficient. 6) However, if symptoms persist or worsen, further evaluation and management by a specialist is necessary.

instruction: Hello doctor,My daughter was born a week back. Upon leaving the hospital her jaundice levels were at 10.2. The follow-up appointment was yesterday and after doing a bilirubin test it went up to 11.2. The doctor stated I should start supplementing with formula as I am breastfeeding. However, she was having 6 to 8 diapers a day with breastfeeding. Please guide.
output: 11.2 mg/DL is still within normal range. There may be some variation in reading from one lab to another depending upon the method used for testing bilirubin. In case of an increase in jaundice level, doctors usually recommend phototherapy which is done by using a special light that passes through your babies skin and helps break down the bilirubin. As long as the baby appears well and has no serious symptoms of jaundice, you need not worry about it.

instruction: Hello doctor,I was born 14 weeks premature and was told that do not circumcise that young. I believe I have a condition called aposthia, but I need help in identifying what it is?
output: 1. The condition you refer to as aposthia can be seen in many different conditions, so it is difficult for me to tell without examining you directly. 2. The most common cause of this type of condition is an injury to the glans penis. This could occur during birth or afterward due to trauma from cleaning, handling etc.3. Injury may also result from sexual activity, so be aware of this possibility if you are sexually active.4. It is important to see your doctor to determine the exact cause since there are treatments available for some causes.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have teeth of yellowish color. How can I whiten it?
output: Hi. Welcome to Chat Doctor.com. Thanks for your query. I understand that you wish to know how to whiten discolored teeth. Well, there are various ways in which one can whiten their teeth. One method is using a home kit available over-the-counter; another way is visiting a dentist and getting a professional treatment done. The home kits usually consist of a tray which fits over the teeth like a glove and has a gel in it. The gel contains either hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide. You just need to apply this onto the teeth and leave it overnight or for some hours, depending upon the instructions on the package. Another way is to get a professional cleaning of the teeth done by a dentist followed by application of a bleaching solution. This will lighten the teeth but will not remove the stains.

instruction: Hi doctor,I took Clearblue ovulation digital test a week back which showed LH surge. I had intercourse three days before and three days after the test. Since then I have been feeling really sick, but not vomiting. I am really sensitive to perfumes and I have started to feel faint and lightheaded even though I have just eaten or had a drink. I have been getting cramps around my tummy area (like I would the day before my period starts), my bra feels tight, my boobs do not look big but bra feels tight. I have been getting pain around where I get pubic hair if that makes sense like sharp tugging pains. I have stopped getting the discharge. I am not sure what it could be. Please, could you advise if it is too early for pregnancy as I am due to start my period between 20th-22nd of this month or do you think it is a virus or bug?
output: 1) The symptoms that you are describing are more likely related to your menstrual cycle rather than pregnancy. 2) It is possible that you may experience some abdominal bloating during the ovulatory phase of the menstrual cycle.3) Pain in the lower abdomen is also common when the period is about to start.4) The cramping sensation of the abdomen can be a sign of implantation bleeding.5) The discharge is an indication of fertilization.6) The symptoms you describe are consistent with the fact that you are near the time of expected menses.7) These symptoms are not related to any type of infection or viruses.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have stupidly just flushed my retainers down the toilet. I had braces removed eight years back and have been wearing them religiously every night since. Unfortunately, there is a storm here. So, all the dental practices are closed. I am worried that my teeth will move before I get an appointment next week. I have a mold of my top and bottom teeth from when I first got my braces removed but I had to change my retainers after getting new crowns and a porcelain veneer in my two front teeth. So, the new ones I flushed down the toilet are different but I would say only slightly. Is there a benefit of wearing these molds until I can get a replacement retainer?
output: 1) You should not wear your old retainers, as they may cause gum irritation if placed over your now-existing crowns and veneers.2) Yes, it is possible for your teeth to shift over the next few days without the retainers.3) You need to see a local orthodontist/dentist ASAP to get a replacement set of retainers made.4) In the meantime, you could try to make your own retainers out of clear plastic or acrylic material.5) For this purpose, you need to take your impressions with some type of putty (e.g., Life-Like or SureSmile).6) Once you have the impression, you can send it to an outside lab for fabrication of a custom retainer.7) I hope this helps! Best wishes.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have been recently suffering from extreme burning back pain on my shoulder blade area. instruction: Hello doctor,My doctor prescribed Diflucan (14 days / 200 mg) to treat urinary candidiasis. I just took day 6 of Diflucan. I am feeling a little better but still have achiness in pelvic area, bladder. My question is how much longer until I get full relief? Is this normal?
output: Hi, I can understand your concern. The symptoms of pain and itching in vulva and vagina may be due to fungal infection called as Vulvovaginal Candidiasis. You should take Fluconazole for at least 7-10 days. It will help you to cure the condition. In case if there is no improvement or aggravation then you need to consult your gynecologist for clinical examination and further management. Hope this information helps. Thanks and regards.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am 27 years old and really worried about developing anaphylaxis to a local anesthetic. instruction: Hello doctor,I had oral sex before months. I did the following tests.1. HIV combo 4th generation (CMIA) during 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th month after exposure. All results are negative.2. HIV combo 4th generation and ELISA during 7th month. All results are negative.3. HIV test from ICTC center in general medical college hospital in the ninth month with a negative result.4. STD tests are also done.5. HCV on ninth month by ELISA method.Now 11 months have passed and I have lymph node under the jawline on both sides. Both lymph nodes are equal in size as that of green peas. It is moving but I do not have any pain. Is it lymph node? Do in normal body is there such type of lymph nodes present? Or is this symptom of HIV? Is this a serious condition?I am 32 years old with good health. I have attached all my reports.Please provide information on what is my status? Should I need to test more or not? What is the size of the lymph node in the normal body under the jaw line? Some say that HIV test may take nine months in some cases, what are they? Sometimes I feel muscle pain and some mouth infection, is ti sign of HIV? As per NACO, there may be very rare chance of some persons to show positive after nine months. Who are they?
output: 11 months has past and you still have lymph nodes which move and look like green pea. This is a sign of HIV. There is no doubt about this. You should go for further testing. You can get tested at any other laboratory. The size of the lymph nodes is not important. The important thing is its presence. I don't know why people talk about nine months. They might be talking about nine months after infection. But I think it doesn't matter when the infection was. Infection can lead to the formation of lymph nodes. So if you have them, you must be infected. Your current situation is similar to someone who is HIV+. The only difference is that you didn't receive treatment yet. So if you want to be sure, you should get tested again.

instruction: Hello doctor,We, husband and wife, are (A+) same blood group. Also, our son is the same blood group (A+). He also had ASD problem treated and surgery also done completed. Will there be any problem for him in the future?

You must get his blood tested for antibodies to see whether he is immune or not.4. If he is immune then nothing to worry about.5. If he is not immune then take care while giving birth that the baby doesn't receive blood from mother during delivery.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 24 years old. I am suffering from myopia for the past four years and now suddenly my vision increased by 1, before it was -2.50 and now it became -3.50. I am really very depressed. Please suggest how can I improve my vision?
output: 1. Myopia is an eye condition in which there is a need to wear glasses to see properly. The degree of myopia increases with age and may increase overnight also due to growth spurt. Hence, if you are having myopic eyes, get your eyes checked once every year to monitor the changes. You should not worry about the change in vision as it is natural phenomenon.2. To reduce the progression of myopia, you have to avoid reading more than two hours a day, preferably use computer instead of books for studying, try to stay away from TV, watch less movies or videos, and you will find that your eyesight will improve significantly.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have this mole on my back. I think it has been there for a while. My GP took one look at it and declared completely benign. I was wondering what sort of mole it is? Is it worrying? I used sunbeds frequently for about a year when I was younger. Never since.

So you should get it examined by dermatologist to rule out any possibility of malignant transformation. It may be melanoma in situ which is also called as nevus simplex. This is not worrisome condition but needs regular follow up with your dermatologist. Hope this will help you.

instruction: Hi doctor,A five month period of pregnancy has been completed for me. I had a screening test for Down\s syndrome which came positive with a risk of 1:69. instruction: Hi doctor,I asked my doctor to do PSA test. The PSA came back normal at 1.0 ng/mL. However, he also did prostatic acid phosphatase test which was high at 4.5 ng/mL. My question is whether prostatic acid phosphatase test is valid for screening or not? Should I need to do these tests again? I had prostatitis symptoms in the past. Now, it seems to be fine.
output: Prostate-specific antigen (PSA) and prostatic acid phosphatase (PAP) are both enzymes that are found in the prostate gland. PSA is produced by the epithelial cells of the prostate gland and is released into the bloodstream. It can be detected in the blood as early as five years before any clinical signs of prostate cancer appear. PAP is produced by the smooth muscle cells of the prostate gland and is released into the semen. Elevated levels of PAP may indicate inflammation or obstruction of the prostate ducts. It is not a routine test but is sometimes used to monitor patients with prostate problems such as benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).

instruction: Hello doctor,In a few sentences, what is the Mediterranean diet? What food categories are typically eaten on the Mediterranean diet? In a few sentences, what health benefits come from the Mediterranean diet? And anything else you would like to add.
output: The term "Mediterranean Diet" refers to the traditional dietary pattern of countries located around the Mediterranean Sea. This includes countries such as Greece, Italy, Spain, and Turkey. It emphasizes plant-based foods such as fruits, vegetables, whole grains, legumes, nuts, and olive oil, while limiting red meat and dairy products. Research has shown that individuals who follow this diet have a lower risk of heart disease and certain cancers. Other potential health benefits include improved blood sugar control, weight loss, improved mental health, and reduced inflammation.
