instruction: Hello doctor,I saw a doctor for abdominal burning and pain in the throat after one night of drinking alcohol. She said I had gastritis but I did not say I had diarrhea as well. What shall I do? Currently, I am taking Lansoprazole.
output: 1) The symptoms of gastritis and gastroenteritis are quite similar, so it is difficult to differentiate between them.2) Gastritis can be caused by many factors like stress, spicy food, smoking, excessive alcohol intake etc.3) In my opinion, you should avoid alcohol and spicy food for at least 4-5 days. You may need an antacid (pantoprazole or omeprazole) along with probiotics (yogurt). 4) Avoid intake of too much water during meals.

instruction: Hello doctor,My urine is foamy. I am confused whether everyone will get bubble and foamy urine while urinating. Please explain me.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. It appears that you have some infection in your urinary tract. You should consult your attending physician for examination of your abdomen and urinalysis. Infective etiology can be confirmed by culture and sensitivity of urine sample. Treatment depends upon the causative organism (bacteria or fungus). It is not normal to have foam in urine. I hope this information helps you. Wish you good health. Thank you.

instruction: Hello doctor,I feel my ears plugged from last week, and nothing I am doing is helping. This happened to me about a month ago, and the doctor prescribed steroid nasal spray, Reactine, and Sudafed. It cleared up within two days, but it is doing absolutely nothing now. I do not feel as though my sinuses (nose) are plugged, but now I am getting a headache. I am getting worried, and is this something serious? Please help.
output: 100% sure that your symptoms are related to allergic rhinitis. The most common treatment for allergic rhinitis is oral antihistamines such as cetirizine or fexofenadine. You may also try an intranasal corticosteroid spray which will provide localized relief of inflammation in your nose. A combination of both these medications is very effective in relieving symptoms of allergies. If symptoms persist even after taking these medications consult a physician for further management.

instruction: Hello doctor,My daughter has been diagnosed with a cylindrical power of -2 and -2.5. Can that be cured to normal if she takes healthy diet and eye exercises? Will it increase with age as she is 5 years old?

So it is better to use glasses or contact lenses in between this period. In some cases of myopia there is no treatment available like in case of high myopia (>-7) or when there is no control over the growth of eye due to other reasons. You should consult an ophthalmologist to know more about your child's condition. Thank you hope I answered your question

instruction: Hi doctor,I met with a car accident three weeks ago. I was injured and had trauma to the chest wall muscles. My chest muscles went into spasm periodically, but has subsided somewhat. My right side lower chest is the only area still hurting. After rest for a long period or sleep, when I activate the muscles in that area I have cramps. You need to take analgesics like ibuprofen to relieve the pain. You can also apply hot fomentation over the affected area. Do not bend forward and lift heavy weight as this may cause more damage to the muscles. Elevating the head end of the bed by putting blocks under the headboard will prevent any further damage to the muscles. Avoid taking any food which causes acidity. In case if the symptoms persist then consult a physician for diagnosis and necessary treatment. Hope this helps you. Wishing you good health. Take care.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have severe anxiety problems which cripple me. I feel trouble in concentrating on my studies and other daily activities. I have PCOS and suffering from depression. instruction: Hello doctor,I am on dialysis for kidney failure and I have noticed a fluctuation in my monthly blood work for the creatinine and BUN levels. instruction: Hello doctor,I was eating a hot curry last week when the top of my mouth blistered over as if I had burnt the hard palate, which I thought was unusual as I felt the heat on my tongue first but did not. output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum, It is very common to have burning sensation after eating spicy food, due to excessive production of saliva and gastric acid secretion. Please avoid spicy food for few days time. You can take an antihistamine tablet like cetirizine or levocetirizine before meals, which will reduce the symptoms. You can also apply ointments containing antibiotics like mupirocin cream twice daily. Hopefully this will resolve your problem. Thank you.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am a 45 year old male. I have recently checked my blood test and my liver function test shows 1.6 total bilirubin, 0.6 direct bilirubin and 0.9 indirect bilirubin. What might be the problem? I have high blood pressure and fatty liver. My current medication includes Covance 25 mg, Concor 5 mg and Storvas 5 mg. I am worried. Please advise.
output: 1.6 bilirubin is normal. It may be slightly raised due to some other reason. So don't worry about it.2. Fatty liver is not a cause of rise in bilirubin.3. You can take these medications till your physician says otherwise.4. Fatty liver needs diet modification and exercise. Take low-fat diet, avoid alcohol, stop smoking if you smoke. Do regular aerobic exercises like brisk walking for at least half an hour daily. Hope this answers your question.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am having pain in the right lower abdomen for a week. Ultrasound suggests subacute appendicitis. CBC, LFT, and KFT are normal. I do not have a fever. What are the treatment options? Is surgery necessary? Can this be treated with medicine only? Currently taking Oflox 200 twice a day. Will Oflox 200 cure this? Please advise.
output: 1) You should get an ultrasonography of the whole abdomen to see if there is any other pathology going on.2) Subacute appendicitis needs immediate appendectomy. It is not advisable to take medicines alone as it will delay the diagnosis and cause more complications.3) In your case since you had an ultrasonography which suggested acute appendicitis, you need to undergo an appendectomy by a general surgeon.4) The antibiotic that you are taking (Oflox 200) is not suitable for treating appendicitis.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am having itching inside my penis since three days. When I urinate, the itching gets increased and after urination, it subsides. There is no rash. Please advice.

instruction: Hello doctor,My partner and I were intimate on the 10th of this month. I used I-pill on the next day. Due to that, I got bleeding on the 22nd which is my period date for four days. Now, I have cramps and back pain but not getting periods. Is it a sign of pregnancy?

instruction: Hello doctor,I had a routine echo done a couple of weeks ago and just got the results yesterday. It can be due to many reasons like heart disease, lung diseases etc. You have to get ECG, chest X-ray, echocardiography and spirometry done for evaluation. instruction: Hello doctor,Today, I plucked a nose hair. I work in a hospital setting, so I guess; I am around with a lot of germs. I read that plucking a nose hair can lead to a cut and some infection inside the nose. Then, this infection can reach the brain and cause loss of vision, headaches and fevers. Is this true? If so, how easy would it be to get this infection from a plucked nose hair?
output: 1) As far as the nose is concerned, there are no nerves. So, if one does not feel pain when he/she plucks a hair then it is unlikely to be a problem.2) The skin is lined by mucosa which is rich in blood vessels. Whenever we injure something like a nose or finger, the blood rushes to this area and creates a swelling.3) Infections are always possible. But, they don't usually happen for minor things unless one has compromised immunity.4) Please do not worry about it.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am a 49 year old male. I have a constant problem of excess mucus in throat. I feel as my food pipe is inflamed. I cannot eat anything. Whenever I eat something this mucus problem gets aggravated. What disease is this? And how to get it treated? Thank you.

For gastritis, proton pump inhibitors (omeprazole and pantoprazole) can be taken. 4) Avoid spicy foods and smoking if any. 5) Consult an ENT specialist if symptoms persist. Hope this helps.

instruction: Hello doctor,I recently had an accident while cycling and twisted my foot. The foot is quite swollen. I have attached X-rays. Are any of the bones in my foot broken? What should I do to recover?

Also take calcium supplements and vitamin D3. Hope it helps Chat Doctor.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 19 years old. Can a Maryland bridge or any bridge move up, down, right or left?
output: Yes, it can. It is not uncommon for a dental bridge to shift slightly after being placed. This can occur due to changes in your bite and/or jaw positioning. The best way to prevent this from happening is to visit your dentist regularly for check-ups and cleanings. If the shifting has already occurred, you may need to have the bridge re-cemented or even replaced entirely.

instruction: Hello doctor,I had sex the last four weeks before my period and after 25 hours, I drank ECP and bled after four days. Then, I have not gotten my period this month. I went to the gynecologist yesterday and she said that she saw a dominant follicle on the right side of my ovary which will almost rupture. Am I safe from pregnancy?After how many days from now should I expect my period to arrive?
output: 1) Dominant follicle means that it has grown in size due to hormonal stimulation. Yes, pregnant woman do have a dominant follicle at time of conception.2) You may be ovulating but it is difficult for us to know without doing an ultrasound.3) Pregnancy can occur if intercourse happens during fertile phase of cycle (day 10-16).4) Period usually arrives 7-10 days after the dominant follicle ruptures (ovulation).

instruction: Hi doctor,I am a 22 year old female. Why does the area, which I believe is my ovaries, hurt when I stretch? The pain would be in both the left and right side. When I sit down for a long time or when I defecate, it hurts a lot in the area. During my periods, why do my legs go numb? Every month around the time, I experience leg numbness, back pain, pain in the butt area, and pain my stomach. I understand the stomach pain, but why do I have pain in other areas? When all this pain starts, I get panicked, as I do not know what to do. I try sitting down for a few seconds, which helps but then, my back pain starts. I try to walk, but the pain is not relieved.I start feeling sick and throw up. I start getting suicidal thoughts, and I just want to put myself out of this misery. When I take two painkillers for the pain, I end up sleeping the entire day and get up only to use the restroom. I do not eat, and I would end up going days without eating until I feel better. So, I just want to know what is the cause of this. This will help me explain my physician to help me better. I feel like this would affect me trying to go to work. I am trying to find a job, but I feel that if I take so many days off for the pain, my boss will fire me.I was thinking of getting a partial hysterectomy to stop it maybe, so I will have to deal with the pains, and I can stay on the job. But I am not sure if my insurance will cover it. Do you have any suggestions? Sorry for the long query, I just really need help. The last physician I had could not help me in the way that I needed help, so I stopped going to her. I need more of professional help.
output: 1) You should first consult your gynecologist for proper examination and evaluation. 2) Your symptoms seem to suggest pelvic inflammatory disease (PID). PID is one of the most common causes of chronic abdominal pain in women of reproductive age group. It occurs due to ascending spread of bacteria from vagina into the uterus, fallopian tubes and ovaries. 3) You may also have tubo-ovarian abscess formation in such cases. Infection may spread to other organs like bowel and urinary tract. 4) Blood test, ultrasound scan and laparoscopy can confirm diagnosis. 5) Treatment depends upon the extent of involvement and type of bacterial organisms causing infection. 6) Antibiotics alone may not suffice for treatment. Surgical intervention is required in some cases.

As the facial bone develops from birth till adulthood (age of 18-20) and due to improper development of jaws the upper and lower jaw may not grow properly resulting into problems such as crowding, gap between front teeth(diastema), protruding front teeth, narrow arches, etc. Please do not worry much about this, as long as you have proper dental care and regular checkups with your dentist, you will be fine. I would suggest you to consult a dentist for diagnosis and treatment plan.

instruction: Hello doctor,I want to ask about halitosis. I already went to the dentist and the dentist said that the problem is not in the mouth and it could be in my stomach so here I am. Periodontal abscesses can also occur and may require antibiotics and deep cleaning by a periodontist.6. Infection from the gums can spread into the bloodstream and affect other organs like the lungs, kidneys, liver etc.7. Treating the infection will resolve your symptoms.

instruction: Hi doctor,My 3.5 year old daughter has irregular bowel movements with a recent problem of mucus in stool. Earlier also, she did not poop regularly. When I consulted a local pediatrician, he stated that mild enlargement of the liver might be there in children, and nothing has to be done. He prescribed a medicine named Livosil B. We used it for 2 to 3 days, but my daughter is still suffering from irregular bowel movement and mucus in stool. Please help me.
output: 1) Irregular bowel movements can occur due to many reasons like malnutrition, worm infestation, food allergy, constipation, etc. 2) Mucus in stools may be due to worm infestation or other causes like gastroenteritis, cystic fibrosis, etc. 3) Enlargement of liver can be due to many reasons like viral infection, fatty liver disease, Wilson's disease, autoimmune disorders, etc. 4) You should take your child to a pediatric gastroenterologist who will examine her and run some investigations if needed.

instruction: Hello doctor,This is regarding my 16 years old son. He is currently in class 10 and giving his board exams. He is academically oriented, has been always good in studies and wants to maintain his good image in front of his peers and teachers. Since last two months, he is having a few problems as follows:He is having problems in his eyes and feels that his attention is drawn to his blinking and he has to blink consciously as he feels his automatic blinking does not happen. If he does not consciously blink his eyes start watering and irritating. He feels this is affecting his concentration in studies. I had shown him to an eye doctor a month back and he said it could be due to dry eyes and prescribed teardrops which he is using regularly since then, but there has been no improvement. Moreover, my son feels it is a problem with his mind and he is not able to get his attention off the blinking of his eyes.Not sure if there is a connection, around two months back he was reading the chapter of involuntary and voluntary actions of the human body in his biology book and that some actions are both voluntary and involuntary. He says his problem started around the same time. He also says that he feels suffocated and often needs to breathe voluntarily. He read about it in the same chapter.He also says that he has to swallow his saliva consciously or voluntarily, something he read about too in the same chapter. Overall he complains more about his eye problem and little less about the above two problems. He is an only child. He does not open up easily but once he does he talks a lot. At home with us and with his few friends at school, he talks a lot. He loves to follow sports. He is not very active but has a normal height (5 feet 8 inches) and weight (65 Kg approximately) for his age. He is myopic since the age of 9 and has the following approximate power: Left eye: -5.5 spherical and -0.5 cylindrical, right eye: -6 spherical and -0.75 cylindrical. We give him nutritious food at home and he is not fussy about food. He has a regular sleep schedule of around 7.5 hours at night. He is worried before going to sleep that he will not be able to sleep due to conscious breathing problem but he does fall asleep and sleeps well after that. Also, he is afraid of lizards and feels that he suffers from the phobia of lizards. He does get scared of insects very easily. Please advise.
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. I understand your concern. Your son seems to have Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD). It is characterized by recurrent thoughts and ideas, which cause anxiety and distress. The person tries to resist and reject these obsessions by performing certain compulsions. These compulsions provide relief, but only temporarily. They feel guilt and shame when caught indulging in the compulsive behavior. OCD is treatable with medication and psychotherapy. Medicines like SSRI (Sertraline), SARI etc. can be tried. Psychological therapies like CBT (Cognitive Behavior Therapy) is useful. I suggest consulting a psychiatrist for further evaluation and treatment. Hope this helps. Take care.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 22 years old. I experience heart palpitations with a skipped beat for three years. Should I take any medicine? How to cure it?
output: 1) Mitral Valve Prolapse only needs to be treated if symptoms occur or there is significant regurgitation of blood back into the left atrium causing an irregular heart rhythm.2) You need to see a cardiologist who will perform an exercise stress test which will show how your heart functions during exercise and determine if you have any problems with your heart and if they can be corrected.3) A Holter monitor may also help determine if you have any problems with your heart rhythm.4) An EKG will give an idea if you have any heart blockages or abnormalities.5) You should avoid excessive exercise until we understand what is going on with your heart.

instruction: Hello Doctor, Is it possible that anxiety causes episodes of bradycardia?

It would be best if you could see a cardiologist for an ECG and possibly a 24-hour ambulatory monitor so that we can rule out any arrhythmias.

instruction: Hello doctor,I have had one sided throat pain for a week now when swallowing, usually have cobblestone appearance on the back of the throat, now my throat pain is slight and maybe more on to the side of where this lump above my tonsil appeared. What does this look like? Could this be a tonsil stone?
output: Thanks for your question on Chat Doctor. I can understand your situation and problem. You are having recurrent tonsillitis with tonsil stones. Tonsils are lymphoid tissue which fights against infection. In childhood it is very active due to its immature mucosa. But as we grow old, our immunity also grows old and thus the tonsils become less active and prone to infections. So we get repeated attacks of acute tonsillitis. And these tonsil stones are also formed in such patients. They are small white or yellowish lumps in the tonsil fossa. These stones are formed by deposition of calcium carbonate crystals inside the tonsil crypts. So better to consult ENT specialist and get done clinical examination of throat. You may need antibiotics along with anti-inflammatory medication. Hope I have solved your query. Wishing good

instruction: Hi doctor,I am 46 years old male. I have a weight of 60 kilograms and a height of 164 cm. I am diabetic for the past ten years. I have an Hba1c of 8.3 %, with no other health issues. I do exercise regularly, and I am taking a healthy diet every day. I am using Gemer 2 mg twice a day, and I am unable to bring Hba1c below 7.5 %.I have an FBS of 130 mg/dL and PBS of 220 mg/dL. Sometimes, I sweat in the morning. When I check my sugar levels, I have an FBS of 120 mg/dL. I am not interested in increasing the dose of Metformin to 1000 mg twice as a concern of weight loss. Would a change in medicine help me to reach my Hba1c target? Please advice.
output: 1) You should definitely try to get your HbA1C down to 6.5% or even lower if possible. This will help reduce your risk of developing complications from diabetes.2) For this reason, it would be wise to increase your Metformin dosage up to at least 1000mg daily (split over two doses).3) Also, you may want to look into adding a GLP-1 receptor agonist such as Victoza or Byetta to help better control your blood glucose levels.4) Regular exercise is also important in helping keep your blood sugars under control. You should aim to do cardiovascular exercise at least three times per week for a total of 30 minutes each session, and muscle strengthening exercises at least twice per week.5) Lastly, make sure that you are eating a balanced and healthy diet.

output: Hi, I have read your question and understand your concerns. The main difference between Escitalopram and Buspirone is their mechanism of action. Escitalopram is an antidepressant belonging to the selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor group (SSRI) while Buspirone is an anti-anxiety medication belonging to the piperazine group. In other words Escitalopram increases the levels of Serotonin in the brain while Buspirone enhances its effect by increasing the sensitivity of the Serotonin receptors in the brain. Both treat anxiety but Escitalopram is more effective in treating depression as well. Hope this answers your question. Please feel free to ask if you have further queries.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am suffering from health anxiety, and I am scared of ALS. I started getting muscle twitches all over my body about six months ago. It started after I stopped taking Valium 10 mg daily for seven months (in suppository form). However, they still occur. I have discontinued Benzodiazepines (Valium and Xanax) for about seven months. I am very focused on my every movement. I have done two neurology exams (one by a psychiatrist and one by a neurologist). Both were normal. I also did two EMG on the same day. The psychiatrist did an EMG, a paraspinal EMG and tested 28 muscles altogether. His impression was healthy except for isolated fasciculation potentials in the right medial gastrocnemius. However, the above muscle was silent at rest with standard motor unit configuration and usual recruitment pattern. He said the study was healthy and did not suggest any motor neuron disease. The neurologist tested again because I made him do it. He did the nerve study and EMG directly on my right hand and arm where I am complaining as well as left hand, left arm, and left leg. He did not find any fasciculations and said it is all normal. The doctor told I do not have ALS. Both the doctors said there is no need to repeat the test. My questions are:Would the EMG directly pick up on the right hand if ALS were present?Should I be concerned about these fasciculations which can turn into something?If the fasciculation is due to ALS, will they show any other issues on the EMG?Can anxiety make fasciculation worse?Is it possible to focus on a body part so much?
output: Hi, Thank you for posting your query. I understand that you had developed fasciculations in your thigh muscles, and this has been confirmed by electrophysiological studies. Fasciculations are not specific for a particular disease process. They may be seen in ALS, but also in other conditions like myopathies or metabolic diseases. So, the fact that the electrophysiological studies are normal does not mean that you don't have fasciculations. You should continue to follow up with your treating physician and try not to worry too much. Hope this helps. Please get back if you require any additional information. Best wishes,

instruction: Hello doctor,I am 30 male. I am suffering from central diabetes insipidus for the last three years. Please advice medicine. currently, I am taking Desmopressin.
output: Hi, Thanks for writing to us. Diabetes insipidus is due to deficiency of antidiuretic hormone (ADH). It can be due to genetic defect or damage to hypothalamus region of brain. The symptoms that you have mentioned are suggestive of same. Desmopressin is the treatment of choice. But it has side effects like increased thirst, polyuria and nocturia. I would advise you to take tablets like acetazolamide which will increase water absorption by kidney. This will reduce the urination frequency and also help in treating the dehydration. You may need to monitor your blood electrolytes while on this medication. Hope this helps.

output: 1. The treatment of your condition will depend upon whether it is arterial or venous occlusion. instruction: Hello doctor,What is seasonal affective disorder and recommend products that can help people manage their symptoms?
output: Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD) is a type of depression that occurs at certain times of the year, usually during the winter months when there is less natural sunlight. It is believed to be caused by changes in the amount of light to which an individual is exposed. The most common treatment for SAD is light therapy. Light therapy is the use of artificial light to replace lack of exposure to natural light, or to supplement it. This therapy involves sitting in front of a special light box that provides bright white light. For best results, one should sit in front of the light box for about 30 minutes each day from early morning until noon. Other forms of light therapy include dawn simulation, which simulates the natural rising of the sun, and blue light therapy, which uses a special lamp that produces only blue light.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am suffering from OCD (Obsessive\x80\x93compulsive disorder). How can it be treated by psychotherapy?
output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. I understand your concern. For this condition, psychotherapy is very effective. It involves individual or group therapy sessions with an experienced and trained mental health professional. The main goal of psychotherapy is to help patients identify their negative thoughts and behaviors and replace them with positive behavioral changes. With psychotherapy, patients will learn how to manage their illness better, develop coping skills, and gain insight into their problems. There are different types of psychotherapy techniques that may be used for obsessive-compulsive disorder like cognitive behavior therapy (CBT), exposure and response prevention(ERP) etc. In ERP, the patient is exposed to his/her fears in a gradual way while trying not to perform compulsions. This helps the patient to realize that the feared outcomes do not occur when they resist performing compulsions. CBT is another useful technique

instruction: Hello doctor,Are there chances of developing chickenpox after shingles?

instruction: Hi doctor,I am a healthy person. I have a cough with white sputum production. I do not have a fever. I have done sputum culture. The result showed a presence of Pseudomonas. Do I need an antibiotic?

instruction: Hello doctor,Prostate biopsy was prompted by rising PSA over several years (20%-25% per year) reaching over 4 this past year (spiked at 7.3 which I think really is why they wanted the biopsy but I expect it to come down since then). 12 core came back benign, but I do not understand the implications for some of the additional descriptive language and why I need continued six months follow-up.DRE had nodules and TRUS shows calcification and volume of 27cc. Path description says reactive and atrophic acini and focally reactive. Does that mean BPH or prostatitis, or is that a precursor to PCa? I have no symptoms of BPH or prostatitis, other than getting up between 3 AM and 4 AM every morning. I think it is just an age factor. I am not interested in the DREs and TRUS procedures if it is not going to tell anything new, and I can have bloodwork done without the time and expense of a doctor\s visit.
output: Hi, Thanks for writing in. Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is enlargement of the prostate gland due to increased size of its cells. It is usually associated with symptoms such as frequent urination, difficulty in starting urine flow, weak stream, incomplete emptying of bladder, etc. The mainstay of treatment for BPH is surgery. Prostate cancer is another common condition in men. It has two types - one is low grade slow growing type and second is high grade aggressive type. Both these types have similar symptoms like painless gross hematuria, dysuria, frequency, urinary retention, etc. The differentiation between both these conditions is difficult. For diagnosis, prostate specific antigen (PSA) test is done. In your case firstly get your PSA level tested. Higher levels indicate presence of prostate cancer. You should also get ultrasound scanning

instruction: Hello doctor,My four month old baby weighs 7 kg. He has a 100-degree fever since today noon. I had given 4 ml of 125 g Paracetamol syrup. But the temperature is still at 100.
output: 1. Fever of few days without any localizing signs could as well a viral illness. Usually rather than fever, what is more important is the activity of the child, in between 2 fever episodes on the same day. 2. If the kid is active and playing around when there is no fever, it is probably viral illness and it doesn't require antibiotics at all. 3. Once viral fever comes it will there for 4-7days. So do not worry about duration if the kid is active. 4. Regarding Paracetamol, it can be given in the dose of 15 mg/kg/dose (max ceiling dose 500 mg) every 4-6th hourly that too only if fever is more than 100F.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 27-year-old female. I had a history of on and off acid reflux for a few years. Last month, I had a bad episode of GERD and was prescribed Pantoprazole for a month. instruction: Hi doctor,Accidentally, I ate pineapple infected with house rat saliva and urine. I suspect it because I saw rat urine and feces near it. Is there any risk for me to get rabies? Please suggest.

instruction: Hello doctor,One of my friends recently pointed out that my pupils are sometimes uneven. I searched and got many scary possibilities. output: Hi, Welcome to Chat Doctor forum. I have gone through your question. I can understand what you are going through. You need not worry about this. This is a normal variation in pupil size. instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 61 year old man and in reasonably good health apart from being overweight and diagnosed diabetic 10 years ago. The following has started after I lost a lot of weight.For the last 9 months, I have had to sleep sitting up in a chair and leaning to my left side. If I lie down to sleep horizontally, or remain sitting up but tilting even slightly backward, or if I slip down on to my back on the chair while asleep, my heart begins to get faster and faster. I feel no pain and it does not wake me up. That is the problem, I sleep through it until I wake up with the need of going to the bathroom. I suspect these episodes last for hours with my heart going dangerously fast. These are not palpitations.When I wake up, my heart is often racing, and I have to take deep breaths for a couple of minutes to get enough oxygen inside me for the heart to return to its normal beat. It all started very suddenly, not progressive. For all these months I have been scared by the prospect of having to go to sleep and leave it as long as possible before trying, just praying that I can get through the night keeping myself upright and with a reasonably clear nose. If I can do that, I can usually make it through reasonably fine, but this is the exception rather than the rule.Body position seems to be one key factor, clear nose another, but the first always overrides the latter in importance. I recently had to make a 6 day 1500 mile dash drive and slept every night upright in the car seat right next to an open window. I had no problems at all during those 5 nights. A cardiologist has run tests and told me there is nothing abnormal with my heart's muscle or function.I rented an automatic CPAP machine for 4 months, but have now returned it. It does not do much of help, but its data shows no continuous waking such as might happen with obstructive sleep apnea. It does, however, show that I go into periods of shallow breathing while asleep. The only other suggestion that I have had is that this might be some form of central sleep apnea and therefore perhaps more neurologically based. The company that rented me the CPAP machine say that a BIPAP machine might be better, as it will force me to breathe, but I would really like a more expert opinion before going down that extremely expensive road.Do you know any other people who have had similar symptoms and experiences, and if so, what was the cause and how was it treated? Current daily medications I take are 75 mg Aspirin for blood thinning, 1 x 15 mg Pioglitazone/ 850mg Metformin tablet for controlling diabetes, 5 mg Ramipril for blood pressure, and various vitamin and fish oil supplements.
output: Hi, Thanks for writing your query, kindly give me little information about your current treatment and history, i will try to guide you further. As far as your sleep disturbance is concerned, you should consult physician and get done polysomnography (PSG) which is a test used to study sleep patterns, it gives detailed sleep report. You may need to undergo other investigations also. Till then avoid stress, tension, anxiety and depression, relax, use soothing music, light therapy, yoga, meditation etc., hope this information helps,

instruction: Hi doctor,I am 32 years old female. I went today for the third follicle scanning on the 18th day. It showed the rupture of follicles, and there was a lot of free fluid seen in a POD. But in my second follicle scanning, on the 14th day, it showed no free fluid. Is it healthy to have free fluid or something wrong?
output: 1) The presence of free fluid is not a reliable indicator of pregnancy. Many women with normal pregnancies will show free fluid on an ultrasound scan, while many women who are not pregnant may also show free fluid. Your best chance of confirming your pregnancy is by repeating the scan in a few days and see if any gestational sac is seen. 2) As mentioned above, the absence of free fluid does not necessarily mean that you are not pregnant. Sometimes there can be interference from nearby structures such as the urinary bladder which can cause false negative results. So, repeat the scan after 3-5 days to find out whether there is any change.

These medicines will reduce the duration of symptoms but it does not cure the disease.4) Once you start taking these medication, you should continue them for at least 5 days even after the symptom has subsided. instruction: Hello doctor,I have done a FET transfer cycle before ten 10 days. My hCG pregnancy test is tomorrow. Are nine days too early to test? instruction: Hello doctor,I started the process of getting four implants. Last week I went for bone grafting. It has been a living nightmare ever since. It is important for controlling the bladder and bowels as well as having a strong pelvic floor which helps with sex. So if you want to do PC muscle exercises then just press down in that area gently and count up to ten. Do this three times per day after you go to the bathroom. Hope I have answered your query. instruction: Hello doctor,I was diagnosed with diastolic dysfunction. The report says velocity E is 84.2 cm/s, and the MVA max velocity is 133.5 cm/s. What does this mean?
output:
09-Aug-2017 11:26 AM
Hi, Diastole is the relaxation phase of heart and diastole dysfunction means that the heart muscle is not able to relax properly during diastole. This causes an increase in pressure within the left ventricle which leads to symptoms like chest pain etc. Your echo report suggests that your maximum velocity (the highest rate at which the pressure changes in the left ventricle) is high which indicates poor relaxation of the heart. The other parameter is ejection fraction which is the percentage of blood pumped out by the left ventricle per beat. It should be more than 50%. In your case it is 45% so also not normal but still better than maximum velocity. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further.

instruction: Hello doctor,I am a 29 year old, who is 1.83 m tall and weigh about 70 kg. output: Hi, thanks for posting your query. You seem to have recurrent gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). This can occur even if there is no hiatus hernia. It may be due to some other causes like hyperacidity, HERD etc. You mentioned that you have taken PPIs, but these medicines will not cure the problem, rather it will only relieve the symptoms. For complete relief with treatment, you need to consult a gastroenterologist for further evaluation and management. instruction: Hi doctor,After deep brain stimulation surgery for generalized dystonia 18 months ago, I have developed mild startle myoclonus a fortnight later and was prescribed 0.5 mg Clonazepam. I am now on 1 mg Clonazepam in the morning and evening. After six months of Clonazepam and just after increasing my dose to 0.5 mg twice a day, I developed pressure of speech and the longer I have been on the drug the worse my myoclonus and anxiety has become. I am now in a vicious circle as the myoclonus episodes are so violent and I fall backwards heavily despite whatever I hold onto. I have become anxious at having an episode and the actual anxiety can trigger a myoclonus episode, although it also occurs when I feel safe such as sitting down, reading a book or chatting with friends.Six weeks ago, I was told to double the dose due to the high number of falls I was having during myoclonus episodes and since then I have developed mini-seizures and worsening of anxiety. My neurologist is referring me to a psychiatrist for CBT for anxiety and now believes anxiety is the likely cause of my myoclonus. I am happy to do this as I just want to overcome my fear of falling. My dystonia also is causing me to fall due to motor control problems with my legs. The behavior of my legs is very unpredictable, so without warning I regularly trip or my legs suddenly buckle, especially when tired or if I am on my feet for too long. Every drug I have been on since been diagnosed with dystonia has caused serious side effects, even at a low dose and I was told by one of the neurologists that my brain is very sensitive to the side effects of the drugs. The anxiety has only developed since being on the Clonazepam and seems to have worsened whenever the dose has been increased. Could Clonazepam cause anxiety?I have now lost my confidence to leave the house, even with my walker as during a myoclonus episode it is so vigorous the walker just tips over with me and I have episodes every day, but just do not know when one may occur. I have not walked as far as the end of my road about 100 meters for nearly five months now and even with friends still feel apprehensive when walking even a short distance with them. I have lost my confidence to stand in the kitchen to do chores in case I have an episode. I often crawl around on the floor, especially when tired as tiredness definitely increases the episodes and the higher dosage of Clonazepam makes me feel very tired by midday.I am also under stress at home as I am a carer of my 86 year old father who has Alzheimer\s, although I get some support from social services with carers, who come in to get him up and his breakfast and then his evening meal. I am normally a very positive person, but right now I wonder if I will ever get better. I am keen to start CBT. But, I am still concerned that Clonazepam initiated the anxiety as a side effect and so would need to withdraw from the Clonazepam in order to recover properly. All I know for certain is I never had myoclonus before my DBS surgery. I never had anxiety or a single fall. Right now, I wish I never had DBS as it done little to help me physically and my quality of life right now is far worse. I am finding it hard to stay positive and feel very discouraged. Please help me.
output: Hi, Thank you for posting your query. Your symptoms suggest that you might be developing seizure disorder which needs to be investigated further. I would advise you to consult a neurologist and get evaluated for possible seizure disorder. In addition, we need to rule out other causes like metabolic disturbances, vitamin B12 deficiency etc. You should get investigated for these parameters as well. Apart from medications, counseling and meditation techniques could be helpful. I hope it helps. Please get back if you require any additional information. Best wishes,

instruction: Hi doctor,I am 23 years old and slim female. Three years back, I had been diagnosed with PCOS, mild stage as doctor said. I had Hyponidd tablets for one year or more. output: 1. Yes, you can wait for some more days. You need to repeat the pregnancy test after a week. If it is still negative then you should consult your gynecologist. 2. So you need to visit an infertility specialist who will examine you and suggest further investigations like USG scan and blood tests - LH, FSH, Thyroid profile etc. and treat accordingly.

instruction: Hi doctor,Around six months ago, I removed four wisdom teeth (one tooth per month). I remember the first two were not very painful, but the third and the fourth ones, especially the fourth, gave me really bad headaches and it even made my whole cheek swell for a few days.Anyways, I also noticed this one tooth from my lower teeth started moving after all of my wisdom teeth were removed, and so I started putting on my retainers at night, but the problem is that in the morning when I eat, that tooth starts moving again and I get a headache eventually during the day.My orthodontist told me that there is nothing wrong with my retainers and that this headache could be caused by me grinding my teeth at night. I have also been told to do a CBCT scan.Any suggestions on what I should do? Should I go back to wearing braces on my lower teeth?
output: 1) The tooth that is moving is called an erupting tooth, and it has to move forward until it reaches its proper position.2) This process can happen anytime between 6 months to 3 years post extraction of the wisdom tooth.3) The reason why it is moving now is because your jaw bones are still forming and healing which is causing the tooth to move.4) You will need to wear a retainer at least till the age of 18 or so.5) Please see a dentist who specializes in orthodontics and have him/her check your mouth as well as take an x-ray to rule out any other pathology.

instruction: Hello doctor,I was recently diagnosed with an anxiety disorder and have not consulted an ADHD specialist. I am afraid of taking Venlafaxine due to potential withdrawal symptoms. Is it recommended to stop immediately or continue until the side effects subside?
output: 1) You need to see a psychiatrist who is experienced in treating patients with ADHD/ADD (attention deficit hyperactivity disorders).2) Venlafaxine is not very commonly used as a first line treatment for these conditions.3) The usual starting dose would be 37.5 mg twice daily rather than once daily.4) You should discuss stopping with your psychiatrist before doing so.5) In general, Venlafaxine has minimal side effects and should not cause any significant problems like this.6) It might be better to switch to another medication if you don't find Venlafaxine helpful.

instruction: Hi doctor,I was going through follicle stimulation. However, I got my periods the day I took the first Humog injection. Is it normal to get the period mid follicle stimulation cycle?
output: 1) The fertility medications used to induce ovulation can cause your periods to come early.2) Follicular growth is monitored by repeated ultrasound scans to determine when an egg is ready to be released.3) Your healthcare provider will advise you to take progesterone to support the growth of the follicle after the egg has been released.4) If the follicle does not grow or rupture within a few days, then your doctor may recommend that you take additional hormones to help the follicle to grow.5) You should have regular follow-up visits with your doctor during this time.6) If the follicle grows and releases an egg, you will need to wait 10-14 days before taking another dose of Humog (human chorionic gonadotropin).

instruction: Hello doctor,I have recently had an eye test done and it revealed that I have astigmatism, also there is a hemorrhage 2 DD superior to macula 2 DD in the left eye and a cotton wool spot 2.5 DD supero-temporal to the optician\s disc in the right eye. I am hypertensive but my BP is under control with medication.My question is could this be related to my BP and what degree of urgency would this be? I have been referred to an eye hospital.
output: 1) Astigmatism does not cause any symptoms unless it is very high or very bad. Astigmatism is a refractive error which means your eyes focus light differently than normal. This can cause blurred vision at all distances. It may be present from birth or it can develop over time. The best way to correct astigmatism is with eyeglasses or contact lenses. You will need to see an eye doctor (ophthalmologist) for an examination of your eyes to determine if these problems are due to astigmatism.2) Your BP is not a cause of either of the findings mentioned above.

output: Hi, Thanks for writing in. I understand your concern regarding high ferritin levels leading to low hemoglobin levels. Ferritin is a protein which stores iron. It will not cause hemolysis (loss of red cells) or decrease in the number of red cells. The only way it will lead to decrease in hemoglobin is if there is increased destruction or break down of red cells. This usually happens when the body produces abnormal red cells or when the red cells get damaged in some way. In both cases, the body tries to remove these abnormal cells from the circulation and thus decreases the amount of hemoglobin. I hope this helps.

instruction: Hi doctor,I am planning to marry a boy who is known to me. But we have the same blood group B positive. Can we have a problem in having children? Or any other health problems? Please clarify my doubt. If a problem is present, give me a solution to avoid it.
output: Hi, welcome to Chat Doctor forum. I understand your concern. There may be some complications if the couple has the same blood group. The commonest cause of infertility in couples with the same blood group is due to antibodies produced by the mother which attack the baby. This can be prevented by using anti-Rh immunoglobulin during pregnancy, but this treatment only works if given before conception. There is no way to prevent Rh antibody formation after conception. In addition, there is a risk that the baby could develop jaundice (yellowing of skin and eyes) soon after birth. This is usually not serious unless it is severe. Hope this helps. Wishing you good health. Regards.

output: Hello! Thank you for asking at Chat Doctor! I carefully read your question and would explain that your symptoms seem to be related to a possible central auditory processing disorder (CAPD). CAPD is a condition which affects the brain's ability to process auditory information. In CAPD, the brain has difficulty interpreting sounds into meaningful language. It is important to know that CAPD is different from deafness or hearing impairment. People with CAPD hear everything just like normal people, but they may have trouble understanding speech. The main difference between normal hearing and CAPD lies within the brain rather than within the ears. People with CAPD often have difficulty following verbal directions, distinguishing one voice among several voices in a noisy environment, recognizing subtle changes in pitch, and listening when someone is speaking softly. CAPD is treated with psychological therapy and behavioral techniques. Hope to have

It also increases blood pressure and suppresses the immune system. Cortisol levels can be measured with a simple blood test called cortisol level. It may be helpful to do an adrenal stress test to check for possible problems with your adrenal glands.

instruction: Hello doctor,My father is 59 years old and suffering from diabetes for the last 15 years within control limit of sugar. Recently, he got attach with a brain hemorrhage on the right side, and he stopped to talk and his right side hand and leg become inactive. Slowly with medication and physiotherapy exercise, he recovered somewhat and able to speak. He can walk with rod support and his hand is still inactive. His creatine level in blood keeps on the higher side from 5.0 to up to 8.0.In the last few days, he started vomiting and unable to digest any foods. Doctor advised for immediate dialysis and is undergoing the procedure. Within a week\s time, this is the second time he is going with the procedure. The first time it lasts for one and a half hours, and for the second time it lasts for three hours. While discussing with the fellow patient taking the procedure, they said this is a regular procedure and may require on a daily basis also.My query regarding dialysis is if once we opted is it a regular procedure? Please clarify the doubt.
output: 1. The treatment of choice for kidney failure is dialysis or transplant.2. Dialysis may be required as an emergency measure when renal function has been lost rapidly and acutely (e.g., due to severe illness such as sepsis).3. Dialysis is usually not needed for chronic progressive loss of renal function (e.g., due to diabetic nephropathy).4. For those patients who have lost all their renal function, dialysis is lifesaving, but the most appropriate long-term management is kidney transplantation.5. If dialysis is started, it will need to be continued indefinitely unless a kidney transplant is done.

output: Hi, Thank you for posting your query. The most common anesthetic agents used in septoplasty include intravenous sedation with propofol and/or fentanyl, along with nitrous oxide (laughing gas) and oxygen. Muscle relaxants like rocuronium may also be required in some patients. The duration of action of these medications depends on the dose administered and individual variations. Typically, the effects of propofol wear off after 2-3 hours. Intravenous fentanyl can cause analgesic (pain relieving) effect for up to 6 hours, while nitrous oxide will provide pain relief for up to 45 minutes. However, there is no way of avoiding the use of these medicines completely. Please get back if you require any additional information. Best wishes,

output: 1) Infantile Hereditary Optic Atrophy (IHOA) is a progressive degenerative disorder of the retina and optic nerve caused by mutations in the gene coding for the protein PROMIN (prominence). output: 1) You may need to restart your gabapentin dose if you are experiencing symptoms of anxiety again, however, there are other options such as buspirone, clonazepam etc. that could be helpful. 2) It sounds like you are having a worsening of your depressive symptoms, which could be due to the stressful events in your life, or it could be related to the anxiety itself. 3) Gabapentin is not known to cause these symptoms, but it can increase fatigue and dizziness. 4) The other possibility is that you are having a worsening of your bipolar disorder, which could explain why you are having both manic and depressive symptoms. 5) I would suggest going back to your primary care physician or psychiatrist to discuss whether the gabapentin needs to be restarted or if another medication should be added instead

Right now we are not planning to have a child so I am worried. I had a normal cycle of 32 to 35 days. So I am expecting my this month period on 22nd. Could you please tell me that is there any chance to be pregnant?
output: 1. You had intercourse on 19th & 20th day of your cycle, so pregnancy is possible if you were ovulating around those dates. 2. To confirm pregnancy, do a urine pregnancy test at home or get it done by gynecologist. 3. If you are positive for pregnancy then you can continue with the I-Pill till 72 hrs of intercourse.4. As you have been taking I-Pill twice, there is no risk of conception in the current cycle. Hope I have answered your question. If you have any further questions I will be happy to help.

instruction: Hi doctor,I drank a lot of strawberry mojitos and they were really dark red drinks. Now, my ejaculate is in strawberry color. It was nice and white in color before the day and there are no other symptoms.
output: 1. There is nothing to worry about it. 2. There can be some change in your semen color due to alcohol intake but it will come back to normal within few days.3. You should avoid such heavy consumption of alcohol as it has many adverse effects.
